title: Music Player Analytics
description_html:
Record song plays and answer analytics queries.

Levels

  1. Part 1: plays
    • add_song(title) returns ids 1, 2, 3, …
    • play_song(song_id, user_id)
  2. Part 2: top songs
    • get_top_k_songs(k) by number of unique listeners, descending; ties by song_id ascending
  3. Part 3: recently played
    • The last n distinct songs a user played, most recent first (default n = 3)

Progressive round: each level unlocks after the previous one passes. Write level 1 so later levels extend it rather than rewrite it.

Source: Candidate-reported Rippling coding round (prep-site write-ups, 2025–26). Candidate-reported; exact wording varies between reports.
